title: SCIF world map briefing on borderless covert organization

tellings.quote: so in the skiff, a secure compartment information facility. I'm in there and there's a map on the wall

plain: Steven Greer, a doctor who campaigns for UFO secrets to be made public, says he was once briefed inside a SCIF, a sealed room built for discussing classified material, where "there's a map on the wall." He tells Michels the briefing showed a covert organization that does not stop at national borders. If true, it would mean the UFO secret is held by a group above or across governments, not by any one country.
